description: 3D Biot-Savart physical-coil + distributed saturating local magnetic-polarization surrogate; NOT nonlinear 3D FEM; does NOT model Maxwell stress self-consistently, eddy losses, material anisotropy, or moving material field
remarks: Source field from finite rectangular current loops and 4-subfilament conductor cross-section; geometrical winding packs are a separate assumption, not a realizable finished coil CAD.
Moving ferromagnetic islands represented by local saturating polarization energy with no field feedback; this can seriously overpredict force and is not a validated steel law.
No Newton/Maxwell-stress cross-check; no convergence in geometry/material/mesh; rank here is reduced-model diagnostic only.

Full-period electromagnetic source power includes only island-induced incremental linkage and copper loss; self/mutual air-source field energy is omitted, though period boundary cancels it for an exact periodic solution.
E_copper accounts eight local coils only, periodic source array and full vehicle scale not accounted.
